newsitem.title: USA: Blount to buy Pentair Inc unit.
newsitem.headline: Blount to buy Pentair Inc unit.

text.p: Blount International Inc said Monday it has signed a letter of intent to buy Federal Cartridge Co from Pentair Inc for an undisclosed amount.
Blount said the purchase will boost Blount's annual revenues by more than 90 percent, and it will be accretive to future earnings.

Federal Cartridge, which makes firearms ammunition, had net sales in 1996 of about $130 million, Blount said. Blount's 1996 sales of firearms and other hunting and fishing accessories totaled $147.1 million.
Federal Cartridge employs about 900 people at facilities in Anoka, Minn., and Richmond, Ind., the company said.
